newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish president in car crash, unhurt.
newsitem.headline: Finnish president in car crash, unhurt.

text.p: Finnish president Martti Ahtisaari and his wife Eeva were unhurt when a car carrying them crashed late on Sunday in southwest Finland, government officials said on Monday.

The couple were returning from a weekend visit to the summer home of Russian president Boris Yeltsin when another car ploughed into the side of the president's reinforced limousine as it drove from Turku airport, they said.
The driver of the other car was also unhurt but two passengers were taken to hospital for checks, a government spokesman said.
